spans.s:
(ई) पूयी r. 1st cl. (पूयते)
1 To split or cleave.
2 To stink.

n. (-यं)
Pus, matter, discharge from an ulcer or wound.
E.
पूय to stink, aff. अच्.

n. (-नं)
Pus, discharge from a wound or sore.
E.
पूय to stink, ल्युट् aff.

n. (-क्तं)
1 Ichor, sanies.
2 Discharge of sanies from the nostrils.
E.
पूय, and रक्त blood.

n. (-तं)
Ichor, sanies.
E.
पूय, and शोणित blood.

m. (-रिः)
The Nimb tree, (Melia azadirachta.)
E.
पूय pus, and अरि inimical; the leaves being used to produce discussion, or the absorption of matter that has formed.

m. (-सः)
1 Suppuration at the joints, white swelling.
2 Matter in the eye.
E.
पूय, and अलस idle.
